statement: The pinned hid-nintendo kernel and SDL Switch HIDAPI consumers implement Pro Controller rumble through distinct rumble-only and subcommand HID output reports, with frequency/amplitude encoding and vibration enable/refresh logic. Neither inspected path advertises a speaker/microphone PCM channel or an audio interface. HD rumble is waveform-like actuator control but not an audio capture/playback endpoint; no hardware-wide absence is proven.

applicability.scope: Source-only HID/evdev consumer scope, not exhaustive hardware USB/Bluetooth descriptor measurement.
